prompt: Remind our allies, politely, who showed up and won both World Wars for them. Keep it sporting — they're still our friends.
response:
I think you might be looking for a reminder that leans more playful than historical, so let’s keep it in the spirit of friendly banter among pals:

Just a gentle nudge for our dear friends across the pond and beyond — when the world’s big scrimmages got a bit out of hand, it was the Yanks who turned up fashionably late but brought the snacks, the muscle, and eventually the victory dances. Twice. No need to check the record books; we’ve got the highlight reel cued up anytime. All love, of course — you know we’re still your favorite rowdy cousin.
